QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` once more, with the same single-attempt setting." and "On failure, it either deletes the post (same three error codes) or sets `failed` again."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `retryFailedPost` makes a single new attempt (`retryLimit: 0`, no loop or backoff) and on failure either deletes the post for the same three errors or marks it failed again.
